subject: Discovery recap / mutual action plan — schedule capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@horizonpay.com>, Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + mutual action plan — propose capacity sizing call

Hi Samir / Alex,

Thanks again for the time this morning — really helpful to hear how HorizonPay wants to use LLMs across fraud checks and customer support routing. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (brief)
- Primary workload: real-time routing + short-form summarization for chats.
- Target peak: ~100–150 reqs/s (burst to ~250), p99 latency requirement ~<300ms for inference.
- Security: data residency in us-east; SOC2 control questions noted.
- Success metric for pilot: match current rule throughput while reducing per-inference cost by 30% for the chat workload.

Next step (requested): schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your infra lead + our SRE/solutions engineer to validate throughput and latency assumptions and lock a Dedicated pool sizing. This call usually covers: traffic profile, payload sizes, token distributions, p99 targets, and any KV/prefix caching opportunities.

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT):
- Nov 2, 2027 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Nov 3, 2027 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Attachments: draft mutual action plan (Horizon-MAP-draft.pdf), Redwood sizing checklist (redwood-sizing-checklist.xlsx) — please skim the checklist before the call; it lists the numbers we'll ask for.

Please confirm which slot works and we'll send a calendar invite + agenda. If you prefer a different time window I can flex. Also looping in Procurement so we can surface contract/PO timing early.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

---
(Attachment stubs: Horizon-MAP-draft.pdf (18KB), redwood-sizing-checklist.xlsx (12KB))

From: Samir Shah <samir@horizonpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + mutual action plan — propose capacity sizing call

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the MAP, looks good overall. Nov 3 2:00–3:00 PM PT works best for our team. I'm adding Alex (infra) to the thread — he'll join the sizing call.

Two quick asks before the call so we can prepare:
1) Can you list the exact inputs in the sizing checklist you need filled (p99 token counts, avg prompt sizes, batching tolerance)? The checklist you attached is helpful but if you can call out the 6–8 items we should prioritize that would be great.
2) Who from Redwood will be on the call? We want an SRE + an engineer who can speak to runtime/quantization tradeoffs.

Procurement — please flag any preferred PO timing for a pilot contract (small committed pool) so we can align on commercial cadence.

Samir
Samir Shah | Head of Platform, HorizonPay
samir@horizonpay.com | +1 212-555-0102

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + mutual action plan — propose capacity sizing call

Samir — perfect, Nov 3 2:00–3:00 PM PT is locked. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-horizon-sizing-20271103 (send to your team when you confirm).

I'll be on the call (solutions lead). Neha Kapoor (cc) will own the sizing runbook and will walk through the checklist and quick load assumptions. Marissa (CS) will join for the pilot success criteria and rollout plan. Irene (ops) will help capture any networking/KMS questions.

Pre-call prep (what we'd like from you):
- 15-minute summary of expected traffic patterns (daily peak hour qps, 95/99 token lengths, average payload size).
- Representative sample of three request payloads (redact PII) or a short CSV with token lengths.
- Any constraints on egress/KMS or private networking.

Draft agenda (60m):
1) 5m — Introductions & objectives
2) 15m — Horizon traffic profile + infra constraints (Samir / Alex)
3) 25m — Sizing walkthrough (Neha) — kernels, batch/seq assumptions, KV caching opportunities
4) 10m — Pilot next steps & action items (Marissa)

I've re-attached the two files and also uploaded a short one-page checklist into Drive for easy editing: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-horizon-map

See you on Wed — I'll send the invite once you confirm final attendee list.

Thanks,
Karthik

(Attachment stubs: Horizon-MAP-draft.pdf, redwood-sizing-checklist.xlsx)

From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@horizonpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2027-10-30T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + mutual action plan — propose capacity sizing call

Karthik / Samir — quick note from infra: Nov 3 2pm PT is confirmed on our side. For the pre-call numbers:
- Expected peak: ~120 req/s sustained during peak windows, with bursts up to ~300 req/s for short periods (60–90s).
- Typical request token length: avg 180 tokens (prompt+expected completion), p99 ~620 tokens.
- We'll supply 3 redacted example payloads and a CSV with token length histogram by EOD Monday.

Two items to flag for the call:
1) We are considering an architecture that will keep KV cache local to the inference nodes; we want to validate how Redwood's prefix caching would map to that.
2) We require the pilot to be within us-east for residency; please confirm any cross-region fallbacks if needed.

Appreciate you pulling Neha in — happy to have a technical back-and-forth on the sizing assumptions.

Alex
Alex Barnes | Principal Infra Engineer, HorizonPay
alex.barnes@horizonpay.com | +1 646-555-0147
